hello.speaker: MAA
hello.text: Hello? Beta? Awaaz aa rahi hai?

choices.text: Maa... kya aapne kal raat call kiya tha? Teen baje?

work.speaker: MAA
work.text: Kaam kaam kaam. Aankhen dekho apni. Video call pe dikhti hain.

night.speaker: MAA
night.text: Teen baje? Main toh dus baje so jaati hoon, beta. Tumne kiya hoga.

night2.speaker: MAA
night2.text: (At three? I'm asleep by ten. You must have called.)

bye.speaker: MAA
bye.text: Achha, so jao. Sunday ko phone karna. Papa bhi baat karenge.
